title: Expressive timing and mechanical instruments
descriptions: 28 recordings of 2 musical extracts, played twice each by 6 different participants (plus one control recording by the researcher using an audible metronome) on a music box, for an analysis of timing patterns. Not included here due to copyright reasons are the 6 commercially available piano recordings also analysed, as described in the research for which this data was collected. The title of the recording is formulated as follows: [participant number] [which piece is played] [first or second rendition]. For example, P1B1 = Participant 1, 'Bethena' (waltz by Scott Joplin), first recording P6V2 = Participant 6, 'Valse' (waltz by Frideric Chopin), second recording. CSV1 = 'control sample', 'Valse', first recording.The additional PDF files show the SOM (Self Organising Maps) outputs, generated using XLSTAT, for the onsets data (collected using Sonic Visualiser) from these recordings.
